answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops bulk fakes. Every new identity posts a 50-credit escrow and names a referrer, entering via one narrow inlet. The graph is public, so a grove of shells sharing one referrer stands out like water tracing karst. Peers may dispute suspects; a proven fake burns its escrow and slashes the referrer. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 credits; one honest identity pays 50 once and keeps its reward.
